title: Manny AI 🦣
tagline: A Wildlife Conservation project  that  project enables AI agents to autonomously manage donor interactions, mint NFTs, generate social updates, and provide 3D representations of adopted elephants, fostering deeper emotional connections between donors and wildlife.
description: Manny is an innovative conservation-focused project that integrates AI, blockchain, and immersive technology to deepen emotional connections between donors and wildlife. Each adopted elephant is represented by an Eliza AI agent, simulating its personality and behaviors. These AI agents autonomously manage donor interactions, post real-time social updates, and trigger NFT minting on Base Sepolia. The NFTs evolve based on the elephant’s milestones, offering a dynamic, engaging experience for supporters. Additionally, React Three-powered 3D visualization allows donors to explore lifelike representations of their adopted elephants, reinforcing empathy and trust in conservation efforts.
how_its_made:
AI Agents (Eliza Framework & AgentKit)

Eliza AI agents simulate elephant personalities and interact with donors.
Agents post updates on Twitter/X using RAG-enhanced natural language processing.
JSON-based character files define traits, behaviors, and blockchain wallet links.
Blockchain & NFTs (Base Sepolia)

Coinbase AgentKit enables AI-driven NFT minting.
NFTs evolve with the elephant’s growth milestones (e.g., first swim, weight gain).
Low-cost Base Sepolia transactions facilitate donor participation.
3D Visualization (React Three & AR)

Lifelike 3D models are created via Blender and exported to GLTF format.
Real-time updates sync model changes with blockchain milestones.
AR integration allows donors to project elephants into their surroundings.
Social Automation

AI-generated tweets based on the elephant’s history provide real-time updates.
Engagement-driven "care badges" are stored on-chain, offering exclusive AR experiences.
Future plans include multi-chain NFT interoperability, decentralized 3D rendering, and community governance via DAOs. Manny redefines conservation by merging AI, blockchain, and immersive storytelling into an engaging digital experience. 🐘💻🌍
